title: I Let My Neighbor Keep the Leaf Blower Until the Quiet Portal Logged It

parts.text: I watched the blower at 7:04 p.m. under a sign that said: QUIET AFTER SEVEN. NO GAS TOOLS. Neighbor Tam called it a finish. I was forty, homeowner, holding the ordinance PDF. I photographed the sign, the time, and the hopper still roaring. Then I let the city portal log the address. Tam's next evening was a rake. Code sent a courtesy that quoted the sign Tam had posted on the HOA board. I did not argue the joke. I argued the file. The street at 7:04 sounds like a street, which is to say leaves and nobody's two-stroke.

social.video_title: The leaf blower kept going after the quiet sign — Part 1/1
social.description: After-seven gas, an HOA sign they posted, a city portal log. Has a neighbor ever used their own ordinance?
